svg.title: Where the jaws closed
svg.desc: Top-down view of where the jaws closed on each full try and stood open on each probe, in cm from the arm's base, with Astra's estimates of the bag's near edge.
svg.text: Where the jaws closed: a 6 × 6 cm search
Top-down, in cm from the arm's base: dots where the jaws closed, rings where probes held them open,
crosses where Astra put the red bag's near edge.
The box is off this view,
about 8 cm to the arm's left.
